   */

public_members.name: resumeThread
documentation:
/**
   * Resumes a conversation with an agent based on the thread id.
   * Threads are persisted in ~/.codex/sessions.
   *
   * @param id The id of the thread to resume.
   * @returns A new thread instance.
   */

members.name: config
documentation:
/**
   * Additional `--config key=value` overrides to pass to the Codex CLI.
   *
   * Provide a JSON object and the SDK will flatten it into dotted paths and
   * serialize values as TOML literals so they are compatible with the CLI's
   * `--config` parsing.
   */

members.name: configOverrides
documentation:
/**
   * Raw `--config key=value` overrides to pass unchanged to the Codex CLI after
   * structured configuration and before SDK-managed or thread-specific overrides.
   */

members.name: env
documentation:
/**
   * Environment variables passed to the Codex CLI process. When provided, the SDK
   * will not inherit variables from `process.env`.
   */

documentation: /** Source classification applied when this thread is first created. */

scope_closure: OPEN_G01; syntax is not functional SDK parity
required_semantic_cases: startThread defers execution; id starts null, resume preserves supplied id
string and ordered text/local_image input normalization
runStreamed lazy generator, usage defaults, invalid JSON and cleanup on return/throw/abort
run accumulates completed items, last agent response, usage and turn failure
structured config vs raw overrides vs SDK/thread managed precedence
explicit environment vs inherited environment, AbortSignal, subprocess exit/errors
output schema temp file lifetime and cleanup failures
platform packaging behavior and exported constructor internal annotations
review source-only unions and all field presence/default/error variants before oracle freeze
implementation_constraint: Reference SDK wraps CodexExec. CVG must reproduce observable contracts natively; executing installed Codex is not parity implementation.
